summary: Click Holdings Ltd. (CLIK) filed a Form 6-K announcing the signing of a strategic MOU to acquire a 15% stake in Flash Mutual Technology for US$0.64 million. The transaction provides Click entry into the Greater Bay Area silver economy via Flash Mutual's infrastructure, including a US$2.5 million profit guarantee. Click forecasts strong demand for the Smart Elderly Care Card and Life Care Robot. The closing is subject to MOU finalization; watch for definitive agreement and regulatory approvals in GBA.
